components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:

            locality:

              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

            pets:

All green. The full suite (the single `AcceptanceTest`, including the new GOLD test `coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold`) passes and the build succeeds.

## What I changed

The GOLD rule needs to be evaluated **at create time** ("has 3+ members *after this create*") and be readable later via `GET`, so I mirrored the existing `namesakeCount` → SILVER pattern: count at create, persist the count, let the mapper read it. Each unit I touched stays small and low-complexity.

- **`AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java`** (new) — a one-method pipeline step (WMC_other = 0) that counts owners sharing the already-assigned `householdId`, seeded at 1 for the not-yet-saved owner.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `countHousehold` step after `countNamesakes` (the `householdId` is assigned earlier by `EnsureUniqueOwnerHousehold`), before `save`.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `householdSize` field with a plain getter/setter, alongside `namesakeCount`.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — `membershipTier` gains one leading `if`: GOLD when `householdSize >= 3`, otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE logic is untouched.
- **Schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`) — added the `household_size` column so all four stay consistent with `household_id`/`namesake_count`.
- **Data** (`hsqldb`, `mysql`) — appended a trailing `NULL` to the positional owner seed inserts; `h2`/`postgres` use explicit column lists and needed no change.
- **`openapi.yml`** — updated the now-stale `membershipTier` description to document the GOLD rule.

Notes on structural impact: I kept the create-time semantics (each owner's tier is frozen at its own create — the third member is GOLD, earlier members keep their create-time tier) rather than recomputing on read, which is the correct reading of the spec. The mapper edit is a single added branch, the new counting logic lives in its own zero-context class, and the entity change is just field+accessors.
